categories.name: Health
categories.description:
Population and individual health indicators — mental health, substance
use, mortality, life quality, healthcare contact. Most sources are FHI
Folkehelsestatistikk tables with 3-year rolling averages.

categories.name: Demographics
categories.description:
Population structure by age, sex, kommune, and bydel. Core denominators
for any rate-based analysis. Includes SSB resident counts and FHI
population projections.

categories.name: Income & poverty
categories.description:
Household income, low-income statistics, persistent low income, and
children in low-income households. SSB EU-SILC-derived series plus
Bufdir's child-poverty kommunemonitor.

categories.name: Education & youth
categories.description:
Educational outcomes — upper-secondary completion, NEET status,
educational attainment by region. Includes bullying and youth wellbeing
indicators that intersect with school context.

categories.name: Social & housing
categories.description:
Social assistance use, household composition, overcrowded housing,
and integration indicators. The bridge between need and the services
that respond to it.

categories.name: NGO supply
categories.description:
Norwegian NGO supply data — chapters, activities, and operational
footprint across the civil-society sector. Pairs with the population
and need indicators to surface coverage gaps.

categories.name: Reference geographies
categories.description:
Canonical geographic dimensions used as join keys across every
indicator: kommune and fylke classifications from SSB Klass.

publishers.notes:
Directorate for Children, Youth and Family Affairs. Publishes the
Barnefattigdom kommunemonitor and related family / child-welfare
indicators at kommune and bydel resolution. Data released under NLOD.

Norwegian Institute of Public Health. Publishes the Folkehelseprofiler
and the underlying Folkehelsestatistikk via statistikk.fhi.no.
Most tables use 3-year rolling averages and standardised ratios (SMR)
to compare kommune-level health outcomes.

Norwegian Red Cross. Source of NGO-supply data via the public
Organizations API (branches and per-branch activities). The Frivillig
Resource Register (FRR) is also from Red Cross but is private operational
data, never exposed via the public API.

Norway's national statistics office. Maintains the StatBank
(statistikkbanken) — the canonical source of demographic, economic,
and social indicators at kommune, fylke, and national resolution.
Data released under NLOD; tables identified by numeric IDs preserved
with leading zeros (e.g. table 07459).

sources.description:
Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet (Bufdir) publishes the Barnefattigdom kommunemonitor on
bufdir.no and ships a single bulk ZIP of `Indikator_*.xlsx` workbooks ("last ned hele datasettet").
Atlas downloads that ZIP (URL discovered from the monitor page), parses sheet `Data` in each
workbook, and loads kommune- and sub-kommune-level time series into `raw.bufdir_barnefattigdom`
so analysts can compare Bufdir's poverty lens with register-based sources such as SSB low-income
statistics.
sources.attribution: Kilde: Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet, Barnefattigdom kommunemonitor
sources.methodology_notes: Children under 18 living in households below 60% of the national median equivalised income (EU-scale). Spines differ per indicator — some series start in 2013, others in 2015 or later. Bufdir's poverty lens complements SSB's register-based measures by adding bydel-level breakdowns for the largest kommuner.

dimensions.meaning: Stable surrogate indicator key for ZIP workbook rows (not Strapi)
dimensions.notes: Derived as SHA-256 fingerprint of the `Indikator_*.xlsx` filename stem; breaks if Bufdir renames workbook files inside the ZIP.

dimensions.meaning: Geographic code from workbook column Region
dimensions.value_format: 0 (land), 2-digit fylke, 4-digit kommune, or longer codes for bydel/delbydel
dimensions.notes: Rows follow whatever geography levels each indicator publishes.

dimensions.meaning: Workbook column Enhet (first category axis), normalised lowercase
dimensions.notes: Mirrors the paired rows in each Data sheet for child vs household units.

dimensions.meaning: Workbook column Tallformat (second category axis), normalised lowercase
dimensions.notes: Paired with category_unit — four tuples per workbook × geography when all rows exist upstream.

dimensions.meaning: Calendar year column from workbook header row
dimensions.notes: Spines differ by indicator — see values_json for the full year map before filtering NAs.

dimensions.meaning: Parsed year→value map for the geography and Enhet/Tallformat tuple
dimensions.value_format: JSON object with string year keys; suppressed cells as null
dimensions.notes: Matches prior raw semantics (full spine per slice); mart reads scalar `value` for the keyed year row.
